question.text: For the reaction <math><mn>2</mn><msub><mrow><mtext>N</mtext></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><msub><mrow><mtext>O</mtext></mrow><mrow><mn>5</mn></mrow></msub><mover><mrow><mo>→</mo></mrow><mrow></mrow></mover><mn>4</mn><mtext>N</mtext><msub><mrow><mtext>O</mtext></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mo>+</mo><msub><mrow><mtext>O</mtext></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math>, rate and rate constant are <math><mn>1.02</mn><mo>×</mo><msup><mrow><mn>10</mn></mrow><mrow><mo>–</mo><mn>4</mn></mrow></msup><mtext> mol</mtext><mtext> </mtext><mtext>lit</mtext><mtext></mtext><msup><mrow><mtext></mtext></mrow><mrow><mo>–</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup><mrow><mrow><msup><mrow><mtext mathvariant="normal">sec</mtext></mrow><mrow><mo>–</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></mrow><mo>⁡</mo><mrow></mrow></mrow></math> and <math><mn>3.4</mn><mtext> </mtext><mo>×</mo><mtext> </mtext><msup><mrow><mn>10</mn></mrow><mrow><mo>–</mo><mn>5</mn></mrow></msup><mrow><mrow><msup><mrow><mtext mathvariant="normal">sec</mtext></mrow><mrow><mo>–</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></mrow><mo>⁡</mo><mrow></mrow></mrow></math> respectively then concentration of <math><msub><mrow><mtext>N</mtext></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><msub><mrow><mtext>O</mtext></mrow><mrow><mn>5</mn></mrow></msub></math> at that time will be

solution.text:
2N2O5→4NO2+O2

From the unit of rate constant it is clear that the reaction follow first order kinetics.

Hence by rate law equation, r=k[N2O5]

Where r=1.02×10−4,k=3.4×10−5

1.02×10−4=3.4×10−5[N2O5]

[N2O5]=3M
